svg.desc: Review one issue: intended flower versus visibly sharp wire, then a clearer alternative. Annotated crops of a generated focus illustration. Boxes identify regions to inspect, not actual camera autofocus metadata. The two views illustrate a proposed next experiment, not proof of what caused a real failed capture. Light editorial presentation: fixed white paper, regular Helvetica labels, fine charcoal lines and restrained green accents.
